_doc: The movement restart (docs/decisions/0014-sample-locomotion.md): Epic's Game Animation Sample locomotion as Epic ships it, assembled in C++ (Source/Padel/Public/Animation/PadelSampleLocomotion.h). Asset paths are the sample's own, copied in by Tools/AssetPipeline/unreal/gasp_migrate.py. Numbers are the sample's (SandboxCharacter_CMC_ABP and CHT_PoseSearchDatabases_Dense), in Unreal units (cm, cm/s, degrees, seconds). On while the console variable Padel.Animation.SampleLocomotion is 1.

Chooser._doc: The sample's Dense chooser. Idle: the idles below IdleBelow, the walk stops from IdleBelow, run stops from RunStopsFrom, sprint stops from SprintStopsFrom, turns in place when ShouldTurnInPlace. Moving: the gait's loops, its starts while starting, its pivots while pivoting (sprint: loops and starts only when not pivoting). The sample picks the gait from the player's input; here the speed now picks it, walk up to RunGaitFrom, run up to SprintGaitFrom, each edge moved GaitHysteresis (a share) away from the current gait so it doesn't flicker.

Steering._doc: The sample's locomotion steering node: the clip's root motion over the next AnimatedTargetTimeS is scaled to reach the pawn's facing, and what remains is corrected over ProceduralTargetTimeS. Off below DisableBelowSpeed of root motion.

OrientationWarping._doc: The sample's orientation warping (graph mode, in the root bone's space): the legs turn onto the pawn's travel where the clip's root motion points elsewhere, the spine to the head turns back. Two changes from the sample, measured on the layer path (restart-step4): its counter-compensation by root motion is off (on, the pelvis's jerk p95 doubled: 410k against 222k without the warp; off, 262k), and the travel it warps toward isn't smoothed (TravelTurnRate, MinSpeed, FadeS: rate-limiting it to 360 deg/s and fading it in above 50 cm/s raised the shuffle's slide from 41 to 64 cm/s).

Lean._doc: The sample's lean (Get_LeanAmount, CalculateRelativeAccelerationAmount): its additive lean blend space, played in mesh space over the locomotion, by the velocity's change across the body over MaxAcceleration (speeding up) or BrakingDeceleration (slowing: the sample's braking with input), scaled ScaleFrom..ScaleTo over SpeedFrom..SpeedTo.

FootPlacement._doc: The sample's foot placement and leg IK: a foot the clip plants (its contact curve, remapped to a speed as the sample's RemapCurves node does: (1 - contact) * 100) stays put until it moves UnplantRadius or turns UnplantAngle, the pelvis settles to keep the legs in reach, two-bone leg IK reaches the IK foot bones.

Trajectory._doc: The sample's trajectory: 30 past samples, 15 future ones 0.1 s apart. The past is where the pawn was; the future carries PadelCore's velocity and acceleration on (as the legacy path does), and turns the facing toward the travel at up to FacingTurnRate when the body already faces within StrafeAbove of it (otherwise it is strafing: the facing holds).
